item.title: Human: Fall Flat Mountain Walkthrough - Level 5 Guide
item.description:
⛰️ Level 5: Mountain

Objective: Scale vertical stone cliffs, push a red train carriage to create a bridge, search a pitch-black cavern for hidden gems, swing across a massive ravine using a rope, and throw loudspeakers into a house. Level Matrix: Difficulty ⭐⭐⭐☆☆ | Est. Duration 20 Mins Mechanics: Ledge mantle climbing, object manipulation, swinging rope physics, and cave navigation.

📸 Mountain Ledges: Scale wobbly stone pillars and learn the art of mantle climbing.

🗺️ Step-by-Step Level walkthrough

Stage 1: The Winding Stone Ledges

  • Walkthrough: You start at the base of a series of stone pillars. Follow the S-shaped path. Reach high with both hands, jump and grab the ledge of the next rock step. Look down at Bob’s feet while holding the clicks, and hold W to pull yourself over. Continue until you reach the grassy upper ridge.

Stage 2: The Red Train Carriage

  • Walkthrough:
    1. On the ridge, you will find a large red boxcar sitting on rails.
    2. Grab the boxcar and pull it backward to clear the gap on the left, or climb directly onto its roof by using its corner bars.
    3. Run along the top of the boxcar, jump across to the adjacent cliff, and follow the path to the entrance of a dark cavern.

Stage 3: The Dark Cave & Gem Hunt

  • Walkthrough:
    1. The cave is pitch-black. Grab the lantern sitting near the entrance.
    2. Carry the lantern to light your path. You will need to jump over a series of gaps inside the cave.
    3. If you are going for the “My Treasure” achievement, search the dark corners of the cave to find 7 glowing green gems and pile them together.
    4. Exit the cave onto a high ledge overlooking a deep ravine.

Stage 4: The Tarzan Rope Swing ⭐ Key Puzzle

  • Standard Walkthrough:
    1. Look up to locate a yellow rope hanging from a tree branch above the canyon.
    2. Walk to the edge of the cliff. Jump, stretch your arms, and grab the rope.
    3. Swing back and forth to build momentum.
    4. At the peak of your forward swing, let go of the grab keys and jump forward to land safely on the rocky platform on the opposite side.
    5. Follow the pathway up to a cottage, pull open the door, and fall into the exit.

💡 Pro Tips & Glitch Hacks

【One-Handed Swing Climbing (Wall Climbing)】
You can scale almost any vertical cliff face in Mountain using the swing-climbing exploit. Grab the rock wall with one hand. Move your camera left and right to make Bob's body swing. When Bob swings upward, quickly grab higher up the wall with your free hand. Let go with the lower hand and repeat. This allows you to climb straight to the summit, skipping Stage 2 and Stage 3 entirely!

🏆 Hidden Achievements & Easter Eggs

  1. ⛰️ What Goes Up: Unlocked automatically by completing the “Mountain” level.
  2. 💎 My Treasure: Gather all 7 glowing green gems hidden inside the cavern and place them in a neat pile. You will need the lantern to locate them in the dark crevices.
  3. 🐒 Tarzan Swing (AH, EO, EO, EO, EO, OOOOO!): Use the rope in Stage 4 to swing across the ravine. Ensure you grab the rope cleanly and swing all the way to the other side to trigger the achievement.
  4. 📢 Silent Hours (Noisy Neighbours): Outside the exit cottage, you will find a set of loudspeakers. Grab the speakers and throw them through the nearest window of the cottage.

📊 Level Telemetry

Parameter Checklist Data Value Recommended Action
Est. Duration 15 - 25 Mins Carry the lantern to prevent falling into cave gaps
Speedrun Record 45.3 Seconds Use swing-climbing to scale the outer mountain walls
Mechanics Used Pendulum Swing Keep your camera centered on the rope when jumping

item.title: Human: Fall Flat Hike Walkthrough - Tips & Secrets
item.description:
Hike Level Walkthrough & Mountain Climbing Guide

💡 Level Snapshot | Difficulty: ★★☆☆☆ | Est. Duration: 30 Mins | Complexity: Easy

Full guide for Human: Fall Flat Hike level, featuring mountain climbing, camping gear, wooden carts, and hike achievements.

1. Hike Level Overview

Hike is a scenic natural level set on steep mountain cliffs, forest trails, and wooden rope bridges. Perfect for learning wall-climbing and cart physics.

2. Walkthrough Steps

Section 1: Mountain Trail & Wooden Cart

Push the heavy wooden supply cart to the base of the rock ledge. Use it as a step to climb up to the upper path.

Section 2: Rope Bridge & Boulder Roll

Roll the large granite boulder down the hill to break the wooden barricade door below. Cross the swinging rope bridge carefully.

Section 3: Peak Summit & Tramway

Climb the final vertical rock face using two-handed wall flapping. Hop on the aerial cable car tram to ride down to the level exit.

3. Speedrun Skips

Boulder Surf Skip: Stand on top of the rolling boulder as it rolls downhill to gain huge momentum and leap straight onto the cable car station platform!

4. Achievements Guide

  • Peak Climber: Reach the highest mountain peak without using the wooden cart.
  • Take a Hike: Complete the level in under 10 minutes.

5. Core Physics Mechanics & Pro Techniques

Alpine Wall Flapping: For sheer rock walls with no handholds, use the alternate hand release technique: look up, hold left hand on the wall, release right hand, pivot your torso slightly, grab higher with right hand, then repeat with left.

Wooden Supply Cart Positioning: Chock the cart wheels with small rocks on slopes before using it as a climbing platform, otherwise it will roll backward right as you leap.

Cable Tram Car Timing: Jump onto moving cable cars from the front boarding gate; leaping from the side often clips your limbs on the doorway frame.

6. Rookie Mistakes & How to Avoid Them

  • Rolling boulders rolling over you: When clearing boulder roadblocks, push from the uphill side and immediately step laterally out of the fall line.
  • Slipping on glacial frost: Snow-dusted rocks have lower friction than dry granite; take shorter strides.

item.title: Human: Fall Flat Tower Walkthrough - Tips & Secrets
item.description:
Tower Level Walkthrough & Spire Climbing Guide

💡 Level Snapshot | Difficulty: ★★★★☆ | Est. Duration: 40 Mins | Complexity: High

Complete guide for Human: Fall Flat Tower level, featuring spiral staircases, wind turbines, bell ropes, and tower achievements.

1. Level Overview

Tower presents a vertical ascending challenge up a floating gothic spire surrounded by strong mountain headwinds and swinging bell ropes.

2. Walkthrough Steps

Section 1: Spiral Staircase Restoration

Reattach missing stone steps using wooden beams to climb the outer spiral staircase around the tower base.

Section 2: Wind Turbine Drafts

Position the wind turbine blades to channel the mountain headwinds, creating an updraft to float up to the bell chamber.

Section 3: The Cathedral Bell Swing

Grab the heavy clapper rope inside the cathedral bell tower. Swing back and forth to ring the bell and break the glass stained window exit.

3. Speedrun Wall Flap Skips

Spire Wall Climb: Use continuous 180-degree wall flapping along the outer vertical pillar of Section 1 to climb directly to the bell chamber in under 90 seconds!

4. Achievements Guide

  • For Whom the Bell Tolls: Ring the cathedral bell 5 times in succession.
  • Vertigo: Stand on the topmost spire pinnacle for 10 seconds without falling.

5. Core Physics Mechanics & Pro Techniques

Vertical Spiral Climbing: Outer spiral steps have narrow margins. Hug the inner tower wall as you climb to shield yourself from wind gusts.

Heavy Battery Transport: Carry power batteries by walking backward while dragging them uphill. It’s slower but much more stable than pushing them forward up stairs.

Cathedral Bell Clapper Swing: Grab the heavy iron clapper rope with both hands. Swing back and forth in rhythm with the pendulum frequency to maximize impact force.

6. Rookie Mistakes & How to Avoid Them

  • Stepping on crumbling stone steps: Keep an eye out for fractured stair treads that break away under your weight.
  • Losing battery cells off the ledge: Place batteries in recessed corners whenever taking breaks during long climbs.
